messages:
Maya: Heads-up — Orbit Labs onboarding sprint next week. We committed to office hours + a hands-on migration lab (dedicated -> private) and an SSO walkthrough. Need to land 3 sessions to cover NA / EMEA / APAC. Anyone blocked for Wed/Thu/Fri?

Jorge: I can do Wed morning PST or Thu afternoon CEST. Prefer Wed for the NA Q&A.

Priya: Thu afternoon CEST works for me. Can cover the SSO piece and send a short runbook.

Evan: I’ll be on call for the migration lab. Fri APAC morning is best so I can join live for kv cache warmup demo.

Zoe: Fri SGT is fine. Can we keep the hands-on limited to 90 mins? Orbit's infra team requested a compact window.

Maya: Good — thanks. I created a quick poll: https://tinyurl.com/orbit-onboard-poll — please mark availability by EOD today.

Liam: Quick question — do we want separate invites for office hours vs hands-on lab? Orbit prefers one invite per distinct audience.

Maya: Yes, separate invites. Office hours = open Q&A (all customer engineers). Hands-on = invite-only (Orbit infra + our eng).

Priya: Agenda draft for SSO walkthrough (to attach to invites): 1) SAML settings checklist 2) common errors 3) live validation steps 4) next-step config. I'll paste the runbook after this thread.

Evan: I'll prepare the migration checklist and a short `kv-cache` warming snippet for the lab. Code block to run during demo:```bash
# warm kv cache
./warm_kv.sh --model redwood-v1 --prefix /user/session
```

calbot: Reminder: when scheduling external invites, include the security contact and the support rotation alias.

Maya: Also FYI — CS Ops flagged Orbit as a moderate renewal risk due to uncertain timeline on their dedicated-to-private migration. We should make the hands-on as frictionless as possible and capture sentiment via a 3-question pulse after each session.

Jorge: Can we add a single-question quick feedback card in the invite? e.g., \"Will this migration remove the biggest blocker for your team? (Yes/No)\"

Maya: Good idea. Add that to the hands-on invite + 3-question pulse post-session. Zoe can own sending the pulse.

Zoe: I can handle pulse and collect short notes. Will also run a short poll on pain areas during the lab.

Maya: Ok finalizing: Wed 10:00 PST — NA office hours (open); Thu 15:00 CEST — EMEA SSO walkthrough; Fri 09:30 SGT — APAC hands-on lab (90m, invite-only). I'll send invites now and include agendas + the single-question pre-invite. Evan — please drop the migration checklist and kv-warm snippet to the shared folder by EOD. Priya — paste runbook. Zoe — prepare pulse.

Evan: On it. Will upload to /shared/onboarding/orbit by 18:00 PST.

Priya: Runbook posted: https://redwood-internal/share/runbooks/orbit-sso.md

Maya: Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll follow up with Orbit contacts and confirm attendee list. If anything changes, post here.
